categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of aluminum alloy components for new energy vehicle (NEV) battery systems. Its main products include battery box housings, battery cell shells, and precision structural parts, which are critical components of NEV power battery systems. The company operates mainly within the automotive manufacturing industry, focusing on NEV battery system aluminum alloy parts.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced aluminum alloy extrusion technology and friction stir welding (FSW) for manufacturing battery box housings. It has a complete business system covering aluminum alloy material R&D, product design, advanced production processes, and large-scale manufacturing. The company holds 142 patents, including 23 invention patents, covering key production processes and product structural designs. It also invests in developing ultra-thin aluminum alloy materials, lightweight double-layer high-strength aluminum materials, and integrated cooling and insulation designs for battery boxes.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major new energy vehicle manufacturers and battery system suppliers such as BYD, Geely, CATL (Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Limited), CALB (China Aviation Lithium Battery), Yutong, and XCMG New Energy. The company serves the NEV industry, covering mainstream NEV types including battery electric vehicles (BEV), plug-in hybrid electric vehicles (PHEV), and hybrid electric vehicles (HEV). Its products are integral to the power battery systems of these vehicles.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with its headquarters and production facilities located in Chongqing and Wuwei. Its sales are predominantly domestic within China. There is no significant mention of overseas operations or markets in the report.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates in the midstream segment of the NEV supply chain, specializing in the production of key battery system components, specifically aluminum alloy battery box housings and related parts. It supplies directly to downstream NEV manufacturers and battery pack assemblers, acting as a critical tier-1 supplier in the automotive battery system supply chain.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company focuses on technological innovation in aluminum alloy materials and manufacturing processes to enhance product performance, safety, and lightweight characteristics. R&D priorities include developing ultra-thin aluminum alloy extrusion materials, high-strength lightweight aluminum alloys, integrated cooling and structural battery box designs, and adapting to emerging battery system integration technologies such as CTP and CTC. It also emphasizes digitalized extrusion control and advanced welding technologies to maintain industry leadership.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of aluminum alloy battery system components to NEV manufacturers and battery pack suppliers. The company uses a direct sales model, including consignment sales where products are placed in customers' warehouses and revenue is recognized upon actual usage. The company recognizes revenue upon transfer of control of goods to customers, typically at delivery or customer acceptance.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading domestic manufacturers of aluminum alloy battery box housings for NEVs in China. It is the largest supplier to BYD for aluminum alloy battery boxes and has established stable long-term relationships with other major NEV and battery manufacturers. The report does not explicitly list competitors but highlights the company's technological and scale advantages as competitive barriers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.91 billion, representing a 6.95% year-on-year increase. Net profit attributable to shareholders was about RMB 193 million, up 1.99% from the previous year. Total assets grew by 46.10% to RMB 3.24 billion, and net assets attributable to shareholders more than doubled to RMB 1.50 billion. The company produced approximately 866,824 battery box sets and sold 812,646 sets in 2024, with a market share estimated at about 6.32% of China's NEV battery box market.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its advanced aluminum alloy extrusion and friction stir welding technologies, enabling lightweight, high-strength, and integrated battery box solutions that enhance NEV battery safety and energy density. Its products support multiple battery system integration technologies (CTM, CTP, CTB/CTC) and various vehicle types, offering customization and high product consistency. The company’s strong R&D capabilities, extensive patent portfolio, and close collaboration with leading NEV manufacturers provide a competitive edge in quality, innovation, and supply stability.
